name: @app-relay/mcp

tools.name: ask_me
tools.description: Send an SMS to a phone number and wait for the reply before continuing. Use this by default whenever you send an SMS and want to continue the conversation — Claude will pause until the person responds. PREFER this over send_sms unless the message is purely a notification that needs no reply.

to.description: Your phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +573001234567)

message.description: The message to send. Max 160 characters.

timeout_seconds.description: How many seconds to wait for your reply. Default 120, max 180.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Check the status of Android devices connected to App Relay.
